integrity: Full analytic proof of the balanced 2d+2d linear intensity-profile interpolation criterion; numerical checks are limited corroboration. Earlier full quotient quantization and phase threshold credited.
scientific_limitations: Two distinct transverse circles; linear reconstruction of degree-d squared-magnitude profile span, not minimal nonlinear phase retrieval or a noise guarantee. Rational-angle phase threshold was established in prior work.
title: Balanced linear intensity-profile sampling on two crossing circles
